messages:
maria: Heads up — audit alert for suspicious visibility. user u-922 (org-3984) showed up reading workspace/proj-5021 which is owned by org-5021. cc @alex @jess :eyes:

alex: Link? can you paste the audit snippet?

maria: Audit log snippet: `time=2028-11-10T09:12:03Z user=u-922 org=org-3984 action=read resource_type=workspace resource_id=proj-5021 endpoint=/api/v1/workspaces`

jess: That's cross-org read. Any RBAC rollouts this morning? @sam were there policy merges?

sam: We merged the role-mapping PR earlier (PR #6241) that adjusted default viewer scopes for partner roles. Pushing a rollback now to be safe.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: refs/heads/release/rbac-rollback commit=abc123 by sam

li: Quick check — KMS logs show no decrypt attempts from u-922, so they didn't access secrets. Looks like metadata/workspace listing exposure rather than secret access.

maria: Agreed. Metadata exposure still bad but contained. Need scope of impact.

alex: Repro steps: with partner header `X-Partner-Role: partner-viewer` hitting `/api/v1/workspaces?member_of=true` returns cross-org workspaces. snippet: `GET /api/v1/workspaces?member_of=true -> 200 [proj-5021, proj-5078]`

jess: If rollback doesn't fix, we should add server-side org filter (`owner_org == user_org`) regardless of headers.

sam: Rolling back now and adding guard: require org_id match user_org unless explicit `cross_org:audited` flag present. Pushing hotfix branch.

sam: Hotfix commit pushed: def456 — adds org filter + audit tag.

ops-bot: Hotfix deployed to prod (us-west-2) in ~3m. Status: success.

maria: I'll run an ad-hoc audit query for the last 24h to enumerate foreign accesses. If >5 unique users we escalate to full incident.

audit-bot: Query results: 3 distinct foreign-user access events in 24h. affected_projects: [proj-5021, proj-5078, proj-5102]

jess: OK that's within our trigger for incident monitoring but still needs follow-up. Action items: rotate any service tokens used by the role-mapper, review KMS key policies, and add deny-list for partner role mappings until tests are in place. :thumbsup:

li: Confirming KMS key policies are per-org; no decrypt events. Recommend rotating the role-mapper service token and add a short TTL. Also add a test that simulates partner headers to catch regressions.

sam: Creating SEC ticket SEC-4827 for postmortem + remediation. Will include coverage for unit/e2e tests and a staged rollout plan.

maria: Notifying CS for possible customer questions and legal as a precaution. I'll draft a brief internal summary.

jess: Good triage. Postmortem items: 1) enforce org filter server-side, 2) expand e2e for partner headers, 3) add alert for cross-org read count spikes, 4) rotate role-mapper token and tighten TTLs.

sam: I'll attach the rollback and hotfix PRs to SEC-4827. Planning a small blast-radius test before next role-mapper change.

maria: Thanks team. Leaving this thread open until postmortem done.
